The user wants me to:
1. Use /workspace as the project root instead of /workspace/project
2. Fix the git "dubious ownership" issue by adding /workspace as a safe directory
3. Run `git status` to see the current state of the repo

action.command: cd /workspace && git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace && git status
